description: The personal transit calendar of one saved chart of the signed-in user: every transit of the Sun … Pluto to the natal planets, Ascendant and MC in the coming weeks, each with its three phases — approach (enters the orb), exact (to the minute, in the given time zone) and separation — retrograde passes, a strength (strong / notable / background), a tone, and «the main contact» of the month; a few sentences on what each transit is about. Answers «when is my peak this month?», «what is coming in December?». 31 days on a free account, up to a year on a paid AstralRead plan. Swiss Ephemeris.

chart_id.description: chart_id from my_charts; omit for the first (own) chart.
